title: Mexican Breakfast Tostadas with Fried Eggs
summary: Crisp corn tortillas topped with smoky black beans, bright salsa and runny fried eggs. A quick, satisfying vegetarian breakfast with fresh coriander and lime.
steps: Warm 1 tbsp olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant, without letting the garlic brown.
Add the black beans, 3 tbsp water and 0.25 tsp salt. Simmer for 5 minutes, then lightly mash about half the beans with a spoon so the mixture is creamy but still chunky. Keep warm.
Heat a dry frying pan over medium-high heat. Toast the corn tortillas for 45–60 seconds per side until hot, lightly browned and a little crisp at the edges. Set them on plates.

Add the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil to the pan and reduce the heat to medium. Crack in the eggs and fry for 3–4 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny, or longer if preferred. Season with the remaining salt and black pepper.
Spoon the warm black beans over the tortillas. Top each tortilla with salsa and a fried egg.
Finish with chopped coriander and serve immediately with lime wedges for squeezing over.
